bullets.text: **5G Supports Livestock Monitoring** — Boldyn Networks is deploying 5G technology in West Sussex to enhance livestock monitoring, helping farmers improve animal welfare and farm resilience amid climate challenges.

**Huawei and HP Patent Deal** — Huawei and HP Inc. signed a global patent cross-licensing agreement, allowing HP access to Huawei's Wi-Fi patents, which may enhance technology collaboration in the industry.

**MWC26 and ITU Conference** — The Mobile World Congress 2026 in Doha will co-locate with the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference, fostering collaboration between industry leaders and policymakers on digital governance.
